01Who to contact

Website operator & data controllerOtto-Emil HeiskanenFinlandapina.app.mankind189@passinbox.com

02Browser storage

The application uses local storage for favorites and, only if you enable it, persistent best scores. The score-storage choice is kept so the site can remember and respect that choice. Local storage is different from a cookie, but both are browser-storage technologies. Unlike a cookie, this entry is not automatically attached to web requests.

EntryPurposeDuration
apina-favoritesGame IDs saved with the heart button. Stored on this device for this site address.Until removed or cleared; no automatic expiry.
apina-bridge-progressBridgeworks designs, completed levels and the last selected level. Written only after you enable “Remember progress on this device”.Until progress storage is disabled or site data is cleared.
apina-game-recordsLocal best scores. Written only after you enable “Remember scores on this device”.Until score storage is disabled or data is cleared.
apina-score-preferenceRemembers your explicit score-storage choice.Until the choice is withdrawn or site data is cleared.
apina-card-pvp-session (session storage)Server address, room code and private reconnect token for an online Offensive Card PvP match you join.Until you leave or finish the match, or the browser ends the tab session.

The favorites function writes its entry after you explicitly save a game. Scores stay in memory by default; enabling “Remember scores on this device” saves them locally. Turning that option off deletes the stored scores and its preference entry. If storage is unavailable, the collection may last only for the current visit. Clearing the entry does not erase hosting logs, emails or any other site’s data.

03Cookies and optional tracking

The apina application does not currently include ad pixels, audience analytics, tracking cookies or external font requests. Its artwork and scripts are served with the site. The hosting or sign-in service may use its own cookies or security mechanisms; those are separate from the favorites entry described above.

No optional-tracking consent banner is implemented because optional tracking has not been added. If non-essential analytics, advertising or tracking games are introduced, the relevant services must remain blocked until any required consent is obtained. Rejecting optional tracking must be a real choice, and consent must be as easy to withdraw as to give. This page is not a substitute for that technical consent setup.

04GDPR rights

  • Access and correction: ask what personal data is held about you and request correction of inaccurate information.
  • Erasure and restriction: request deletion or limited processing where the legal conditions apply.
  • Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interests for reasons relating to your situation. Direct-marketing objections must be respected.
  • Portability: request qualifying data you provided in a usable electronic format where processing is automated and based on consent or a contract.
  • Withdrawal: withdraw consent for processing that relies on it, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

The current site does not make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

05Making a request

Email apina.app.mankind189@passinbox.com with the subject “Privacy request”, describe your request and provide enough information to identify the relevant correspondence or interaction. Do not send identity documents unless additional verification is specifically necessary and requested.

Requests will be answered without undue delay, normally within one month. If a lawful extension is needed for a complex request, you will be informed within that first month with the reason. Requests are generally free; legal exceptions may apply to manifestly unfounded or excessive requests.

The operator does not receive your locally stored favorites or scores through the application. Use the browser-storage control above to remove that list directly.

06Complaints

You may complain to a supervisory authority in the EEA country where you live, work, or believe an infringement occurred. In Finland, the authority is the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman. You do not have to contact apina first to exercise your right to complain.

The European Data Protection Board’s authority directory lists national authorities.

07Further reading

Official guidance: EDPB guidance on data protection and cookies and European Commission guidance on privacy requests.
